invariants.name: every ops-home tile equals its own source view
invariants.oracle: every ops-home tile's number equals its own source view under the same identity - 9 v_* reads, so 9 chances for a tile to outlive its query

invariants.name: multi-hive resolves to ONE hive, everywhere
invariants.oracle: a multi-hive worker resolves to exactly one hive deterministically, and the tiles all name the SAME one - the .maybeSingle()/limit(1) class that bounced multi-hive users before

invariants.name: worker_profiles upsert is identity-pinned
invariants.oracle: the worker_profiles row written is the caller's own, proven by auth_uid, never by the name in the form

invariants.name: anon reaches zero hive rows through every read
invariants.oracle: an anonymous session receives zero hive rows through every one of the 13 reads - not 'the tiles are empty' but refused-or-0-by-policy, proven at the request layer
